hands.cantHold: {item} isn't something you hold (armor is worn).
hands.ownItems: Drag an item from this character's own sheet.
hands.full: {name}'s hands are full : no room for {item}.
hands.notOffHand: {item} isn't in the left hand : an off-hand attack is with what that hand holds.
settings.handsMain.title: Main Hand
settings.handsMain.hint: Which hand is your characters' main hand on the sheet.
settings.handsLight.title: Held Light
settings.handsLight.hint: A torch, lantern, lamp or candle in a hand lights the token. Light and burn time : a lit effect for the time it lasts (torch 1 hour, lanterns 6 on a flask of oil); burnt out, a torch is used up, a lantern needs oil.
hands.outOfOil: {name}'s {item} runs out of oil : taking it in hand again uses a flask of Oil.
hands.noOil: {item} is out of oil and there's no flask of Oil to refill it.
hands.notBothHands: {item} is held in one hand : a two-handed attack needs both.
rules.weapon.offhandLight: {item} isn't Light : only a Light weapon makes the extra (off-hand) attack.
hands.improvisedMain: {item} isn't a weapon : attacking with it (an improvised weapon) is from the main hand.
classes.paladin.smitePrompt: Which smite, and what pays for it?
classes.paladin.smiteUsed: {name} has already smitten this turn (a Bonus Action).
classes.paladin.noSmite: {name} has no smite spell prepared, or nothing left to cast it with.
classes.paladin.noHit: {item} : {name} has no melee hit to smite (use it from the attack card's Smite button).
classes.ranger.noPay: {name} has no Favored Enemy use or spell slot left for {spell}.

classes.ranger.noConcentration: {name} is no longer concentrating on {spell} : nothing to mark.
settings.spellMaterials.title: Costly Materials
settings.spellMaterials.hint: A spell material with a cost (Identify's 100 GP pearl). Off : a focus or Component Pouch covers it. Item : one in the inventory, named in the material and worth that much (used up when the spell consumes it). Coins : that much money instead (spent when the spell consumes it).
settings.ammoRecovery.title: Ammunition Recovery
settings.ammoRecovery.hint: When a combat ends, half of the ammunition used in it can be found (2024 rules : a minute's search, rounded down; the rest is lost). Thrown weapons can all be picked up.
settings.homebrewAmmoRecovery.title: Recovering Ammunition
settings.homebrewAmmoRecovery.hint: With Ammunition Recovery on (Equipment). Hit Recovery : only ammunition that hits can be found, in the creature it hit, once its damage is applied (1d4 : 1-2 breaks); a thrown weapon that hits lands in it too. Misses with ammunition are lost.
settings.homebrewAmmoRecovery.oddRoll: Half, an odd one decided by 1d2
ammunition.lodged: {item} from {name} lodges in {target} ({roll}) : it's in {target}'s inventory.
ammunition.lodgedThrown: {item} from {name} lodges in {target} : it's in {target}'s inventory.
settings.homebrewAmmoSearch.title: Shared Search
settings.homebrewAmmoSearch.hint: Everything shot and thrown in the fight (NPCs' too) is one pool : when the combat ends, each kind found has a Take button for everyone.
ammunition.title: Ammunition Recovery
ammunition.ownHint: half of the ammunition each used can be found, and thrown weapons picked up (a minute's search).
ammunition.whoSearches: Select your token (or have a character assigned) to search.
ammunition.thrownRow: {name} : {item} thrown, all can be picked up
ammunition.poolHint: found after the fight. Take what you want : each goes to whoever takes it.
